method: Original-format 977-word page, clean extension profile per model, batch 3, concurrency 6, application cache off. Two different providers may run at once; never two models of the same provider. Routing groups run alone after individual routes. Each attempt has a 45-second translation deadline; a timeout is a failed target attempt, not a completed-translation latency. Upstream caching/load uncontrolled. One screening run per model; fastest candidates need isolated repetition and quality review. The selected connection model retains its explicit reasoning override; other routes use their lowest catalogue-advertised UI-supported effort.

runs.method: Real public page in a clean Chromium extension profile. Select approximately the requested word count in complete article paragraphs, restrict translation to them, automatically scroll to untranslated paragraphs. Timer starts immediately before page.start. Model output is nonstreaming. Includes bridge, model, scheduling and DOM rendering; excludes browser/page load. Application cache disabled; upstream prompt caching is uncontrolled.
runs.requestTimingNote: Browser network events may not expose offscreen worker requests; DOM timings are authoritative
